svg.title: Keep the frontier. Bound the claim.
svg.desc: A separate research track protects the compute mission from unproven dependencies. An oxygen experiment is not a demonstrated planetary atmosphere-generation system.

g.text: GOLDSTAR / ORBITAL
CONCEPT STUDY / REV B / 08
Keep the frontier. Bound the claim.
A separate research track protects the compute mission from unproven dependencies.
BASELINE / orbital data experiment
Benchmark a hybrid accelerator on Earth
Qualify power, thermal, and radiation behavior
Test optical contacts and durable storage
Fly a small demonstrator before constellation scale
Advance only when measured budgets close
RESEARCH / surface oxygen production
Define the chemical reaction and feedstock
Measure reactor energy per mass of oxygen
Compare surface power with beamed delivery
Include pointing, atmosphere, and conversion losses
No yield or terraforming timeline established
OPTIONAL DATA INTERFACE
Telemetry and experiment scheduling may be shared; reactor power and hardware are separate.
An oxygen experiment is not a demonstrated planetary atmosphere-generation system.
NOT TO SCALE · PROPOSED SYSTEM · NO FLIGHT PERFORMANCE IMPLIED
